column1: # The ESCAPE HATCH, and nothing else. Empty is the normal state.
# This lane's subject is the REFERENCE HAND PORT's own MUnit suite run against the mechanically
# emitted `sge.ai.*` (`PROGRESS.md` §10.7.12). It runs NO migration, so it has no
# `run-latest/dropped-types.tsv` and nothing here can be DERIVED — which is exactly why the two
# rows below have to be stated rather than left to a mechanism, and exactly why each one is a claim
# someone has to defend.
# BOTH ROWS ARE ONE FACT, AND IT IS THE PORT BEING RIGHT. `Task.cloneTask()` in java instantiates
# the task reflectively (`com.badlogic.gdx.utils.reflect.ClassReflection.newInstance`); this port
# DROPS that package, because Scala.js and Scala Native cannot do it, and emits java's own
# documented escape hatch instead — a `TaskCloneException` naming `Task.TASK_CLONER`, which is what
# upstream itself tells a GWT user to set. The emitted refusal is LOUDER than java and never
# quieter (`CLAUDE.md` §1's rule for a residue an engine translation created).
# The REFERENCE port answers the same question differently: it added a `newInstance()` member to
# `Task` so that cloning needs no reflection at all. That is a REDESIGN of the library's surface,
# not a translation of it — so these two tests assert the hand port's answer against the mechanical
# port's, and java's own source is the oracle where the two disagree. The suite's fixtures still
# DECLARE `newInstance()` (mapping row M7 drops only the `override` keyword, since this port's
# `Task` has no such member to override); what they cannot do is make this port's `cloneTask()`
# call it.
# WHAT WOULD MAKE THESE ROWS WRONG. If the port ever gained a `TASK_CLONER` default, or if
# `cloneTask` stopped throwing, these tests would pass and `test-failures.tsv` would report the
# declared rows for deletion. If a DIFFERENT failure appeared in either test, `frame=` stops
# holding and it counts UNEXPECTED — which is the whole reason the frame is here.
# `test` may be `*` to declare a whole suite.
#suite
sge.ai.btree.TaskSuite
column3: this port drops com.badlogic.gdx.utils.reflect (not portable to JS/Native) and emits java's own documented TASK_CLONER escape hatch; the hand port redesigned Task with newInstance() instead — PROGRESS.md §10.7.12
